title: CRMF extensions to the NIST IR 8286 register row
description: The register row is adopted in the published NIST IR 8286 Rev. 1 format (eleven fields: identifier, description, category, likelihood, impact, exposure, response type, response cost, response description, owner, status). This file declares the fields the framework adds as extensions, so that a row remains valid under the base schema and carries the framework's attributes. The base schema is NIST's and is referenced, not copied.

id.description: Persistent identifier, unique within the organization.

catalog_version.description: Catalog version the record was created under (C1.1; seventh principle: currency is a field).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record validates against.

version.description: Version of this record; rises on every change (nothing changes silently).

owner.description: Named owner (a person or role, never a function alone).

validated_statement.description: Validated risk statement (C2.2) [11]: condition, departure, asset, consequence.

taxonomy_node.description: Node of the source-organized taxonomy, three levels, with an 'other' branch at every level (C2.1) [3].

process.description: Process the risk sits in (source by process matrix, C2.1).

consequence_per_objective.description: Consequence assessed against each objective it touches; the row's impact carries the maximum (C1.6, C3.2).

likelihood_precision.description: How the likelihood was obtained (estimated, modelled, measured) and from what (C3.2) [12].

scale_version.description: Version of the versioned bands behind likelihood and consequence (C3.2).

expected.description: Once the response is live, as written in the selection report.

measured.description: Computed from the loss and near-miss bases after go-live.

response_cost_actual.description: Actual cost of the response (planned cost is a base field).

opportunity.description: True for a positive risk (C2.6); the three positive responses are realize, share, enhance.

source_of_information.description: Events, cases, data the row rests on, with dates.

scored_under.description: Versions the row was scored under.
